properties.name: Falling Ball - Endless
properties.description: Endless falling, Speed 10 to 80, Phase, warned shifting gates, safe practice, coin combos, cosmetics, varied daily challenges and quick retry. The labelled main game loop and every asset are contained in this JSON.

// Internal speeds 24 to 94 are displayed as Speed 10 to 80 (display offset: 14).
// Everything, including the main game loop, lives in this project.
// Density thresholds use the displayed speed, not the internal speed offset.

// HIGH-SPEED WALL DENSITY — gradually bring groups closer above displayed Speed 35.

// between groups for reaction and the roughly 0.42-second two-lane move.
// Initialize audio directly from a user gesture, as required by mobile browsers.

const nextGoal=()=>progress.stars<1?'Survive 20s to unlock the Mint ball':!progress.cleared?'Survive 60s to unlock the Gold ball':progress.totalClose<5?'Make 5 Close! escapes for the Violet ball':progress.missionSet<1?'Finish a mission set to unlock an aura':'Try a new trail in Looks';

const missionHint=()=>{const m=missionTargets();return progress.missionCoins<m.coins?'Collect '+Math.ceil(m.coins-progress.missionCoins)+' more coins':progress.missionWalls<m.walls?'Pass '+Math.ceil(m.walls-progress.missionWalls)+' more walls':'Survive '+Math.ceil(m.time-progress.missionTime)+' more seconds';};
// DAILY CHALLENGES rotate between coins, unassisted wall streaks and Close! escapes.
const dailyDescription=()=>progress.dailyType==='coins'?'Collect '+dailyTarget()+' coins':progress.dailyType==='clean'?'Pass 10 walls in a row\nwithout Phase or a shield hit':'Make 3 Close! escapes';
